integrity: All statements are mathematically proved within the stated block-model assumptions. Finite checks support algebraic reproducibility but do not constitute independent audit or physical validation. Previously known spectral criteria and two-group reductions are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: The capacity threshold is exact only for symmetric, fully connected, constant-within-class and constant-cross-class finite patch networks with a common local extinction benchmark. It is not a theorem of perpetual survival for a finite absorbing stochastic process; it does not establish habitat-location, nonlinear or asymmetric dispersal optimality. Complete early primary full texts and a relevant supplement were not accessible.
title: An exact integer-composition penalty for cross-habitat metapopulation rescue
